entities.name: Marwyn
entities.description: An elf druid, diplomat and the most respected midwife of the Kelfae elves, from Kelfae in Llanowar.

entities.name: Kelfae
entities.description: An elfhame of Llanowar on Dominaria.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: The elven forest on Dominaria where Kelfae lies.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Llanowar is found.

entities.name: Echoverse Marwyn
entities.description: The version of Marwyn in the Echoverse created by the Theorist, the foremost clearcutter of the Kelfae.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A nation whose encroaching forces pressed the elves of Llanowar in the Echoverse.

events.summary: Marwyn negotiated a treaty with an angry group of elves from another elfhame at the bedside of a mother in difficult birth, handing the newborn to the opposing leader.
events.quote: Marwyn famously negotiated a treaty with an angry group of elves from another elfhame

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Marwyn was the foremost clearcutter of the Kelfae, harvesting Llanowar's trees to survive against Benalia.
events.quote: Marwyn was the foremost clearcutter of the Kelfae

relations.note: She is a diplomat and midwife of the Kelfae elves.
relations.quote: the most respected midwife of the Kelfae elves
